Text:
Raises population cap to 500 for ALL civilizations.
Doubles villager training (2 per train).
Boosts gold, stone, berry bushes, and huntable animals to 50,000 each.
Trees and farms unchanged.

Works with all 25 current civs, including Vikings and Scots (Raiders of the North).

All the Big Poppa fun with smoother performance on most PCs. Want even bigger battles? Check out BIG POPPA (1000 Pop Cap).
